rewrite.target_signal: opcode (pre-decode) / reg_write, alu_src_imm, alu_op, zero_en, branch_en, alu_result (L5 slices)
rewrite.description: Extracted one-hot opcode pre-decode wires (op_is_beq through op_is_halt) from 4-bit opcode, shared across ALU control block, main FSM EXEC branch, and next-state DECODE. Replaced 10-entry case statement in ALU control with direct AND-OR boolean equations for each control signal L5 slice. Simplified ALU result to direct mux on alu_op[1]. Added derived shared signals op_src_imm, op_uses_sub, op_writes_rf.
rewrite.expected_improvement: WNS +5-15%, TNS +5-20% (92% historical success rate for cpu_fsm)
